text:
emma: Quick sync: aiming to publish release post tomorrow 10am PT. Need final changelog blurb, docs permalink, a one-line bench callout for the hero, webinar time, and confirmation on lead-routing tags. Can eng confirm canary cadence and any public caveats?

 raj: Canary plan: 10% at T+5m, 40% at T+45m, 100% at T+4h if metrics stable. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/589. Note: KV cache warm-start and adaptive batching both included.

 kai: Docs staging: https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/release-1-2-3. API example updated to show `batching: adaptive`. Need final signoff from raj on the example responses.

 raj: Signed off on examples. Public caveat: small payloads might see slightly higher median latency initially while caches warm; we'll add a short note.

 deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by @raj at 2024-05-20T17:00:00Z. Observability hooks attached: latency_p95, error_rate.

 lina: Bench blurb: "Adaptive batching cut p95 by ~18% on chat-mix workloads and reduced token cost by ~9%." I'll make a shorter hero line for the blog.

 emma: Lead routing: we'll tag forms with campaign=may_release_1_2_3 and channel=blog. HubSpot -> SFDC mapping ready.

 kai: Docs permalink: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1.2.3.

 emma: Final checklist: raj paste final changelog sentence here; lina shorten bench line; kai confirm docs slug. Planning to publish 10am PT if green.

 raj: "Enabled adaptive batching, improved KV cache warm-start for faster initial responses, and rolled out a staged canary with auto-rollback on error spikes."

 lina: Hero blurb: "p95 down ~18%, token cost down ~9%."

 kai: Docs slug confirmed.

 emma: Locking announce at 10am PT tomorrow. Thanks all :rocket:
